applicabilityBasis.summary: Gate markets GUSD as a principal-protected yield product, but it is also fixed at a 1:1 subscription and redemption rate, transferable, tradable, and usable as collateral. Public materials do not identify the legal issuer or instrument terms needed to determine whether GUSD is a GENIUS payment stablecoin or an excluded security or investment product.

references.label: GENIUS Act statutory text — payment stablecoin definition

genius.notes: The public GUSD materials reviewed do not name the token's legal issuer or issuer domicile, and Gate's corporate overview does not establish which Gate entity owes the GUSD obligation. Gate's exchange proof-of-reserves reports customer and platform GUSD holdings rather than the backing assets, so it is not treated as a GENIUS reserve disclosure or monthly token-backing attestation. Gate operates regional businesses including Gate US, but the reviewed sources do not establish whether GUSD is offered or sold in the United States. MiCA remains unassessed because neither the responsible issuer and token classification nor an EU offer or admission-to-trading record was established.

references.label: Gate GUSD minting and RWA help article
